purpose: First local side-tangle prerequisite for Menasco1984 Lemma1 case2 meridional-surgery survival; no use of knot Schubert as a link theorem.
statement: Assume countable choice. A smooth sphere meeting an unknot twice cuts it into two arcs that each cobound a disk with a boundary-sphere arc, with disk interior in its ball.
proof: Transport the standard unknot disk, make transverse rel boundary, remove intersection circles by innermost sphere-disk replacement retaining the original boundary; remaining one intersection arc splits the spanning disk into the two boundary-parallelism disks.
interface: New countable-choice lemma only. Original main full-AC Statement and all ten preceding sources frozen.
